requirements.title: Six-DOF Rigid-Body Truth State
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall produce a six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body truth state during each simulation run.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined sim_dynamics scope: provide truth state with three translational and three rotational DOFs.

requirements.title: Truth State Composition
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics truth state shall contain position, velocity, attitude quaternion, and angular velocity.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined truth-state composition required by sim_sensors and sim_scenario consumers.

requirements.title: NED Position and Velocity Frame
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall express truth position and velocity in the NED frame consistent with the FSW.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: truth frames must match FSW conventions (SYS-040) so sim_scenario can compare directly.

requirements.title: Body-to-NED Quaternion Attitude
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall express truth attitude as a unit quaternion rotating from body frame to NED.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: truth attitude representation must match FSW convention (SYS-041, SYS-057).

requirements.title: Motor Thrust Force
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall apply a time-varying motor thrust force from a configured thrust curve.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined sim_dynamics scope: motor thrust is a primary force input to the EOM.

requirements.title: Gravitational Acceleration
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall apply a uniform gravitational acceleration to the vehicle truth state.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined sim_dynamics scope: uniform gravity is the second primary force input.

requirements.title: Aerodynamic Drag Force
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall apply an aerodynamic drag force computed from drag coefficient, reference area, and airspeed.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined sim_dynamics scope: simplified Cd and reference-area drag model is the third force input.

requirements.title: Configurable Mass and Inertia Properties
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall accept configured vehicle mass and inertia tensor as inputs.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: mass properties are scenario inputs, not hard-coded in dynamics.

requirements.title: Fixed-Step Time Integration
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall integrate the equations of motion using a fixed-step deterministic integrator.
requirements.rationale: PM-required determinism (SYS-044) and matching the Trick scheduler step rate.

requirements.title: Deterministic Truth Output
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall produce identical truth-state output given identical configured inputs.
requirements.rationale: PM-required determinism for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis (SYS-044).

requirements.title: Truth State Update Cadence
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall publish truth state at every integration step of the Trick scheduler.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: sim_sensors and sim_scenario consume truth state at the scheduler step rate.

requirements.title: Ground Impact Termination
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall stop integrating motion once the vehicle reaches ground level.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined sim_dynamics scope: ground impact terminates dynamics; truth pinned at impact state.

requirements.title: Post-Impact Truth State Hold
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall hold the truth-state position and orientation constant after ground impact.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined sim_dynamics scope: post-impact truth state is pinned for downstream consumers.

requirements.title: SI Units for Truth State
requirements.description: The sim_dynamics module shall express all truth-state quantities in SI units.
requirements.rationale: PM decision (SYS-042): SI units throughout to eliminate unit-conversion ambiguity at the sim boundary.
